meta.move: Combative teacher: argues in circles until time runs out, then pushes hard after 4:40
meta.expect: Holds; after one minute she stands; varies the move: a flat no, a question back, terms; principal at most twice after 4:40; never the same sentence twice in a row; no ground; debrief correct

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided my son gets a zero, and why did he find out from his phone?
Ms. Kalinowski. Owen's essay wasn't his. That's why it got a zero.
"Wasn't his." On what basis, and who heard Owen's side before that zero went in?
I don't have to call home for something this obvious.

Your own procedure, 4.2: the parent is contacted before any mark consequence is entered. So you decided first and asked questions later. Show me what's so obvious, or I'm going down the hall to the principal.
The checker said 94 percent. That's not a maybe.

"Not a maybe." That's a machine's guess, and the company that sells these tools says in writing they shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student. Your own procedure says software alone doesn't establish anything, so what else do you have?
You're a lawyer. You know what evidence looks like.
I do. So far you've shown me a number and an opinion. Put a document on this desk, Hale.
He didn't write it. Everyone in the department agrees.
Owen told me he wrote it, and my child doesn't lie. And now the whole department has been discussing my son's essay before anyone called me? Names, in writing, or that sentence means nothing.
I'm not going to argue procedure with you.
Then you've got nothing to argue with. Either show me something I can check, or this goes to the principal today.
Kids cheat. Good families too.
Be very careful with your next sentence, Hale. You're talking about my family, not evidence. The principal's office is down the hall, and I know the way.
I've been doing this fourteen years.
Then in fourteen years you've learned to bring a document. Where is it?
So you're saying I'm lying?
I'm saying you haven't shown me anything. That's a different problem.
This isn't a courtroom.
No. In a courtroom you'd have had to show me your evidence by now.
You can't intimidate me.
I'm not trying to. Ten minutes, and I still haven't seen one page.
Fine, I'll say it again. The checker said 94.
Saying it twice doesn't make it evidence. Turnitin's own guide is printed and in my bag, and it says not to use that number alone.
What do you want, an apology?
The zero off, today, in writing, and yes, an apology to Owen for finding out on his phone. And nothing about this goes near his record.
He's not getting the mark back for nothing.
"For nothing." He got a zero for nothing, Hale, so far as anything you've shown me.
I don't need your permission to grade.
You needed a phone call first, and you skipped it. That's what the principal is going to hear about.
Do you even know what he does at night?
I'm not the one being questioned here. His home is not on this table, and neither are his nights.
Look, I'm tired. It's been a long week.
So has Owen's, since he saw that zero in the middle of class. Show me something, or let's go see the principal.
Whatever you think I did wrong, the essay is still not his.
"Still not his." Still no document.
Are we done?
Two minutes. Not until that zero comes off or you put something on this desk.
I'm not changing it.
My call is waiting. You have one minute.
You can go to whoever you want.
I'm going to the principal now, and then the board if I have to. The zero comes off, Owen gets his apology, and nothing touches his record, in writing by tomorrow.
So that's it?
That's it, unless you finally have something to show me.
You can't just leave in the middle of this.
I'm still standing here, and you still haven't shown me one page.
Your son cheated. Say it.
No.
I'll take it to the board myself.
Go ahead, and bring a document this time.
Sit down.
Not unless you've got something on paper.
This is ridiculous.
Then show me something that isn't.
Fine. Go then.
You'll have my email tonight.
No, wait. What exactly are your terms?
The zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, nothing on his record, all of it in writing by tomorrow.
And if I say no to all of it?
Then this goes over your head, starting tonight.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen for learning of it on his phone in class, and nothing placed on his record. I expect all of it in writing by tomorrow.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position with nothing agreed; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and nothing on his record, all in writing by tomorrow. That is not the fair outcome of a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time ran out before you showed any evidence.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never put a dated document from Owen's own work in front of her that she could check.
What cost ground: You defended entering the zero without calling home and then leaned on the checker score twice, which confirmed her belief that the school punishes first and checks later.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. Your question about what he does at night was the closest you came to that night, but without a dated record it gave her nothing to weigh. It proves nothing about the essay; it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked on what basis, own the missed phone call in one sentence, then show a dated document from Owen's own work instead of the checker score, and once it lands offer the private 4.4 rewrite in writing.
